title: Thutmose IV
summary: King listed in CFAH-8 Table 14 (Egypt Dynasty 18).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasty 18. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-8 (Table 14, "CFAH-Corrected Reigns for Dynasty 18").

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (CFAH non-anchor dates). No tier 1–4 birth year. The year is the reign-start figure already printed on dates.reign: Year BC: 929-920; Yrs: 9 y 8 m. Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-11-13): was none.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-8: Placing Dynasties 15-18," OSF preprint v1.2 (29 Apr 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/Z5RTD, file CFAH-8_v1.2.pdf, Table 14 "CFAH-Corrected Reigns for Dynasty 18", pp. 101–102
reign.note: Row "Thutmose IV + AHIII" of Table 14 (Egypt Dynasty 18). The row is printed "Thutmose IV + AHIII" (with Amenhotep III as co-rex).

reign.citation: BLK SHP Scott, Dynasty of Slaves, Appendix, Egyptian Inscriptions & Papyri
reign.note: Dream Stele: he says Thutmose IV was not the original heir. No BC year is printed. The erased princes are not named and are not made people.
